_purpose: Concept contracts. The canonical layer canonicalises a FINANCIAL CONCEPT, not an API tag. `PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment` describes how a number was obtained; it does not establish that four issuers mean the same economic thing by it.
_rule: 同一個名稱底下，我們到底在量哪個金融概念 —— 這是 v3.4 之後的主要瓶頸。任何跨發行人的加總都必須先宣告 concept_id，且所有成分必須屬於同一個 concept。混用不同定義而共用一條線是禁止的。

CASH_PPE_CAPEX.definition: Cash purchases / additions of property and equipment, as reported in the investing section of the cash flow statement.
CASH_PPE_CAPEX.aggregation_condition: All components must be this same concept. An issuer reporting only a company-defined total cannot be summed into this line.
CASH_PPE_CAPEX._amzn_note: Amazon books the line under PaymentsToAcquireProductiveAssets. Same economic concept, different tag — which is precisely why the contract keys on the concept and lists tags as variants rather than the other way round.

INFRASTRUCTURE_CAPEX_BROAD.definition: Company-defined capital expenditure including finance-lease principal payments. This is the figure several hyperscalers headline in their earnings releases.
INFRASTRUCTURE_CAPEX_BROAD.aggregation_condition: Never mix with CASH_PPE_CAPEX in one series.
INFRASTRUCTURE_CAPEX_BROAD._why_separate: 融資租賃是 AI 資料中心產能可觀且變動中的一部分。把含租賃與不含租賃的數字加在同一條線上，會讓「增速」反映的是各家揭露口徑的變化，而不是支出的變化。

_selection.rationale: Cash PP&E is the concept every one of the four reports on a comparable basis. The broad figure is the more economically complete measure but is not uniformly available, so it is tracked separately rather than blended in.
_selection.gap_disclosed: 此序列因此系統性低估基礎設施總支出，且低估幅度隨各家租賃占比變動。這是已知的概念邊界，不是誤差。
